item.text: {"analysis":"The trial failed source validation with invalid syntax at line 207 because ranking_loss contains literal ======= conflict markers and duplicated code. Training and evaluation did not run; allocated GPU time was 0.0 seconds and no validation score was produced. Repair requires replacing the corrupted section with a single ordered definition of rows, sampled_indices, indices, feat, and target before the existing scoring and loss calculation. The proposed repair was not successfully applied in this submission.","code_summary":"One independent SASRec model per category, each with 96-dimensional item and positional embeddings, two causal Transformer blocks, two attention heads, dropout 0.3, and a learned item bias. Training uses sampled-softmax cross-entropy with 2,048 shared negatives and balanced sampling of up to 2,048 target positions, combining endpoint and positional-mean losses. AdamW uses learning rate 0.001 with three-epoch warmup. Validation selects one checkpoint per category; the generated predictor routes each category to its single checkpoint without ensembling."}
